Sentences and Paragraphs.name: sentences_lesson_2
Sentences and Paragraphs.title: Lesson 23: Intermediate Paragraphs
Sentences and Paragraphs.description: Type longer paragraphs with varied sentence structures.
Sentences and Paragraphs.content: Touch typing is an essential skill in today's digital world. By practicing daily, you can significantly increase your typing speed and accuracy. Remember to maintain proper posture and hand position.

Sentences and Paragraphs.name: paragraphs_lesson_1
Sentences and Paragraphs.title: Lesson 24: Advanced Paragraphs
Sentences and Paragraphs.description: Type multi-paragraph texts with complex vocabulary.
Sentences and Paragraphs.content: Mastering touch typing requires consistent practice and proper technique. Start with basic finger placement on the home row, then gradually progress to more complex combinations. With regular practice, you'll develop muscle memory that allows you to type without looking at the keyboard. This skill will save you countless hours over your lifetime.

Advanced Mastery.name: advanced_lesson_1
Advanced Mastery.title: Lesson 25: Technical Texts
Advanced Mastery.description: Practice typing technical content with special terminology and symbols.
Advanced Mastery.content:
def calculate_wpm(words, minutes):
    wpm = words / minutes
    return f"Your typing speed is {wpm:.1f} words per minute"

print(calculate_wpm(320, 5))

Advanced Mastery.title: Lesson 26: Literary Texts
Advanced Mastery.description: Type complex literary passages with varied vocabulary.
Advanced Mastery.content: The autumn leaves danced in the wind, a whirlwind of crimson and gold against the azure sky. In that moment, I felt an inexplicable connection to the rhythm of nature, as if the universe itself was breathing with me.

Advanced Mastery.name: advanced_lesson_3
Advanced Mastery.title: Lesson 27: Speed Drills
Advanced Mastery.description: Challenge your speed and accuracy with timed typing exercises.
Advanced Mastery.content: Modern technology has transformed how we work and communicate. Digital literacy now includes touch typing as a fundamental skill. Employers increasingly value fast, accurate typists who can efficiently handle information. Learning this skill early provides lifelong benefits across countless professions.
